recovery_notes: Public metadata supplies identities and receipts. It does not contain corpus rows, credentials, checkpoints or weights.
A matching SHA-256 and byte count can recover duplicate paths from the same verified private content.
Credential and contact scans are indicative. They do not clear a corpus or prove absence of personal information.
Path-only inventory excludes operational staging files and independently restored copies made by this milestone.
scope: All initial files under the audit and MOM-BPE evidence roots, project configurations and notebooks, relevant snapshot and encoder entry points, plus the ignored test cache. Generated backup work is excluded.

text_kind_glossary.AUTHORED: authored diagnostic, annotation or engineering text
text_kind_glossary.DEPENDENCY: dependency package, resource or installation file
text_kind_glossary.DERIVED: includes token strings, sequences, individual diagnostic examples or learned rules
text_kind_glossary.NONE: no raw or derived corpus content identified
text_kind_glossary.PROSE_OR_CODE: report or implementation source, which may include small illustrative strings
text_kind_glossary.PROVENANCE: document coordinates, names, hashes, attribution or split metadata
text_kind_glossary.RAW: contains original or extracted document text or an indexed copy
text_kind_glossary.WEIGHTS: tensor and optimizer state without dataset sequences
